description: Piano Nazionale Banda Larga is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Marche. Il piano nazionale banda larga –volto a portare a tutti i cittadini la connettività da 2 a 20 mbps – è in fase di completamento. Ha interessato oltre 8 milioni di italiani che nel 2008 erano in divario digitale, ovvero non erano coperti dal servizio di connettività di base. Coverage: Regione Marche. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Marche. Its tags are N_A. It offers 3 resource(s) in JSON, XLS, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
